name: Cambridge Nutritional Sciences plc
summary: Established in 1987 and headquartered in London, UK, Cambridge Nutritional Sciences plc (formerly Omega Diagnostics Group PLC until its name change in September 2023) is a specialist in the development, manufacturing, and supply of medical diagnostic products. The company primarily operates within the food sensitivity testing market, creating and producing "Foodprint" branded kits designed to detect immune reactions to food. Beyond manufacturing, it provides clinical analysis services directly to the public, clinics, and healthcare professionals, and also offers the "Food Detective" consumer food test. Its diverse client base includes government entities, private hospitals, reference laboratories, nutritionists, naturopaths, and other medical practitioners. Cambridge Nutritional Sciences plc boasts a global presence, serving markets across the United Kingdom, continental Europe, North, South, and Central America, India, various other Asian countries and the Far East, Africa, and the Middle East.
